settings.sub2apiNote: Add Sub2API sites and keys without a remote check. Keys stay on this computer (sub2api.json in the app's settings folder) and are sent only to that site's /v1/usage. Shared wallets and subscriptions are shown separately for each key.
footer.refreshPartial: Updated {time} · {names}: refresh failed, showing earlier data
footer.proxySaved: Proxy saved — takes effect after restart
footer.configSaveFailed: Settings were not saved and may be lost after restart: {err}
footer.traySyncFailed: Tray display could not update; it will retry: {err}
footer.onenewapiNotCompatible: This is not a OneAPI / NewAPI compatible site
settings.title: Settings
settings.minimalTip: One starred (or first) meter per card — hide plan chips, extra rows, links, and share
settings.glassTip: Turn off on slower PCs — replaces the glass refraction with a simple solid look
settings.reduceAnimTip: Skip card entrance motion and the day/night wipe. Windows' own 'Animation effects' setting is still respected.
settings.notifyNote: System notifications when a weekly or monthly window resets, a quota worsens, a long limit burns unusually fast, or the day's spend passes your mark. Each fires once, then re-arms.
settings.burnAlertTip: A weekly or longer limit climbing this fast. Catches an agent fan-out long before the pace projection does.
settings.burn10: 10% of a weekly limit in 30 min
settings.spendAlertTip: Today's total across every tool, from your local logs. On a flat-rate plan this is the API-equivalent value, not a charge.
settings.networkNote: Applies after the app restarts. Local usage API always runs at http://127.0.0.1:6736/v1/usage
settings.apiKeysNote: Stored only on this computer. Leave empty and save to remove.
settings.keyPhKimi: Kimi For Coding plan key (if you don't use kimi login)
settings.advancedNote: Restores every preference to its default and re-detects installed tools. API keys and your usage history stay. Proxy changes still need a restart.
settings.customizeHint: Providers, row order, and tray-strip stars live in Customize (☰ in the sidebar). Star up to 2 metrics per provider there to show them as tray icons.
settings.resetBody: Theme, density, notifications, shortcut, proxy, pacing, tray stars, and card layouts go back to defaults. Installed tools are re-detected. API keys and usage history stay. A proxy change still needs a restart.
settings.onenewapiNote: Register OneAPI / NewAPI compatible sites. Keys stay on this computer (onenewapi.json in the app's settings folder) and are sent only to that site. Empty sites stay here; cards appear after you add a key.
settings.onenewapiFamilyTip: Turns off every key card at once. Per-key switches in Customize stay.
settings.onenewapiDeleteBody: This removes the site and {n} API key(s). This cannot be undone.
settings.onenewapiMigrateBody: {n} API key(s) will be sent to the new origin. Last-good quota for those cards will be dropped.
settings.onenewapiKeyKeepHint: Leave empty to keep the current key
card.notStartedTip: Sessions start after you send your first message.
card.creditDying: This credit expires in {time} — use it or lose it.
stale.reloginDefault: add the API key again in Settings (or sign in with the tool once)
stale.fixRetry: The app keeps retrying automatically — nothing to do unless this persists.
stale.fixDone: The app recovers automatically once that's done.
stale.fixRelogin: Fix: {how} — the app picks it up on the next refresh.
stale.fix429: The vendor is rate-limiting; the app waits exactly as long as it asked, then retries by itself.
stale.fix5xx: The vendor's API is having trouble; the app retries automatically until it recovers.
stale.fixNet: The app couldn't reach the vendor — check your internet connection (or the proxy in Settings).
stale.tail: Showing the last good data meanwhile.
stale.relogin.claude: run `claude` in a terminal and sign in
stale.relogin.grok: run `grok` in a terminal and sign in
stale.relogin.copilot: run `gh auth login` in a terminal
stale.relogin.cursor: open Cursor and sign in again
stale.relogin.devin: run `devin` in a terminal and sign in
stale.relogin.opencode: run `opencode auth login` in a terminal
stale.relogin.antigravity: open Antigravity and sign in again
stale.relogin.hermes: open the Hermes desktop app once so it writes its local ledger
unpriced.tip: {n} requests ran on models with no public pricing ({models}). Their tokens are included, but they can't be turned into dollars — so the real cost is a little higher than shown.
spend.title: Total Spend
spend.emptyFirst: No spend data yet — appears once Claude Code, Codex, or another CLI logs some usage on this computer.
spend.emptyPeriodTip: No spend recorded in this period.
spend.info: Fed by: {names}. All figures are local estimates from each tool's own logs.
spend.clickTip: {exact} — computed locally from session logs. Click to show {next}.
spend.trendTip: Last 30 days ({from} – {to}) · peak {tokens} tokens on {peak} · from local logs
spend.noModelData: No model data for this period.
welcome.title: Welcome 👋
welcome.body: You're set up with the AI tools found on this computer. Arrange cards, star tray metrics, and hide rows in Customize.
customize.resetAllTip: Restore all cards' default layouts — does not touch your usage limits
customize.resetLayoutTip: Restore this card's default layout — does not touch your usage limits
customize.onDemand: On Demand — behind the card's caret
customize.noData: No data yet — refresh with this provider enabled first.
customize.resetBody: Order, stars, and hidden rows go back to defaults, and installed AI tools are re-detected. Your usage limits are not affected.
resets.confirmBody: Immediately reset your usage limits. This can't be undone.
resets.noNeed: Your usage doesn't need a reset yet
resets.gone: That reset is no longer available
resets.failed: Couldn't reset usage. Please try again.
resets.none: You have no rate limit resets
detail.panel.label: Details
detail.chart.historyStarts: History starts now. A reading is saved on this computer at each refresh, so this fills in over the next few hours.
detail.chart.ariaLabel: Percent of each limit used over time
detail.chart.caption: Percent of each limit used. A drop to zero is a reset.
detail.forecast.hitsAt: {metric} runs out {when}, at the pace of the last {hours} hours.
detail.forecast.hitsAtHour: {metric} runs out {when}, at the pace of the last hour.
detail.forecast.hitsAtPeriod: {metric} runs out {when}, at this period's average pace.
detail.forecast.flat: {metric} has not moved lately: it holds at {pct}% until the reset.
detail.forecast.reaches: {metric} reaches about {pct}% by the reset, at the pace of the last {hours} hours.
detail.forecast.reachesHour: {metric} reaches about {pct}% by the reset, at the pace of the last hour.
detail.forecast.reachesPeriod: {metric} reaches about {pct}% by the reset, at this period's average pace.
detail.week.empty: This fills in as the app watches you work: after a few days it shows which hours of the week use a limit hardest, so heavy work can be planned around the reset.
detail.week.ariaLabel: Points of {metric} used in each hour of the week
detail.week.hardestWithReset: Hardest hour so far: {day} around {hour}. Next reset: {resetDay} {resetHour}, outlined.
detail.week.fromDays.one: From {n} day of readings on this computer, over the last four weeks at most.
detail.week.fromDays.other: From {n} days of readings on this computer, over the last four weeks at most.
detail.spend.noLogs: No local spend logs for this tool. Spend is read from the logs a command-line tool writes on this computer.
detail.spend.areaCaption: A work area is the top-level folder a session was working in: where its shell was, or the files it touched. "(unsorted)" is spend before a session had gone anywhere.
detail.spend.projectSingleCaption: Projects are the folders Claude Code was started in. Everything here ran from one folder, so there is one row.
detail.spend.weekChange: {money} in the last 7 days, {dir} on the {lastMoney} before.
detail.spend.weekNoPrior: {money} in the last 7 days; nothing the 7 before.
detail.spend.footer: From local logs, priced at API rates. On a flat-rate plan this is equivalent value, not a charge.
detail.effort.caption: Per commit, last 30 days: {parts}. Folders outside git are left out. A commit is not a unit of work, so read this as a ratio, not a score.
detail.client.budgetTip: Optional. Alerts once when this client's month passes it.
detail.client.rulesCaption: Folders as they appear under Work area. A plain folder covers everything beneath it, * is a wildcard, and the first matching client wins.
detail.csv.saveTableTip: Save this table as a CSV in your Downloads folder
detail.csv.saveShownTip: Save what is shown here as a CSV in your Downloads folder
detail.session.revealTitle: Show this session's log file in {where}
detail.session.drillCaption: One row per Claude Code session, most expensive first. Times and totals only: conversation titles and content are never read.
detail.session.noneIn30: No sessions in the last 30 days.
detail.session.allCaption: One row per Claude Code session, most expensive over the last 30 days first. Times, sizes and totals only: conversation titles and content are never read. Reveal shows the log file in {where} so you can archive it yourself; the app never deletes a session, because these logs are also where its spend figures come from.
detail.card.noTrend: The 24-hour trend appears once a few readings are saved.
detail.card.sparkAriaLabel: Percent used over the last 24 hours
detail.panel.wideTip: Show the list and this page side by side
